evals.prompt: Build me a personal portfolio website. I'm a frontend developer. I want something dark, futuristic, with a 3D animated background — maybe floating particles or a rotating geometric shape. Include sections for hero, about, skills, projects (show 3 placeholder projects), and contact. Keep it to a single HTML file with vanilla JS so I can just open it in a browser.
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained index.html file that opens in a browser with: a dark theme, a Three.js or CSS 3D animated hero, at least 3 sections beyond the hero (about, skills/projects, contact), scroll animations, responsive layout, and no external dependencies requiring a build step.

evals.prompt: I'm launching a SaaS product called 'Luminary' — an AI-powered analytics dashboard. Create a landing page with React + Vite. I want: glassmorphism cards, an aurora gradient animated background, a pricing section with 3 tiers, a features section with animated icons, and a hero with a 3D sphere using Three.js. Dark color scheme, purple/blue accent.
evals.expected_output: A complete React + Vite project with package.json, all component files, Three.js hero scene, glassmorphism CSS, aurora background animation, pricing table, features section with animations, and a working dev server setup.

evals.prompt: Design and code a creative agency website for 'Apex Studio'. Bold, brutalist aesthetic mixed with smooth GSAP animations. Include: a full-screen video/canvas hero, a horizontal scroll section showcasing 5 case studies, a team section with 3D tilt cards, and a contact form. Use Next.js. I need the complete project including a simple Express backend to handle the contact form submissions.
evals.expected_output: A Next.js project with all pages, GSAP scroll animations, 3D tilt card implementation, horizontal scroll section, contact form wired to an API route or Express backend, complete package.json, .env.example, and README with setup instructions.
